node.statement: Universal constant ledger. Let e_add>0 be a universal accuracy threshold implicit in lem-extcb-corner-dimension-additivity. With C_nest,e_nest, e_ncd, C_out,e_out, e_sim, and C_ca,e_ca denoting the universal witnesses in the correspondingly named registered externals, set C_delta=max{1,C_nest,C_out}, C_s2=max{1,C_delta+2*C_ca}, and e_s2=min{1/2,e_add,e_nest,e_ncd,e_out,e_sim,e_ca/2}. These are positive finite universal constants, independent of m,U,j and every amplification. If t<=e_s2 and epsilon_A<=t, then t+epsilon_A<=2t<=e_ca and every named comparison, dimension, transfer, equivalence, additivity, and corner-algebra threshold used below is met; in particular the e_ca threshold and C_ca coefficient are absorbed exactly as the root requires.
